Ordering & delivery

How do I place an order?

Add items to your cart and select “Continue on WhatsApp”. You can review the message before sending. No account is needed, and adding to a cart does not reserve an item or place a paid order.

How do I pay?

We confirm the exact products, availability, total price, delivery costs and timing with you on WhatsApp. You then pay by bank transfer to the account we confirm in that conversation. We do not collect card details on this website. Ask for an itemised order confirmation and payment acknowledgement.

Where do you deliver?

We are based in Akure, Ondo State. Tell us your delivery area on WhatsApp so we can confirm whether delivery is available, its cost and the estimated date before you pay. Any assembly or installation service must be agreed separately.

What about colours, sizes and custom furniture?

Confirm dimensions, material, colour, included accessories, condition and any warranty before payment. Room photos are inspiration; items are sold separately unless the listing explicitly says otherwise. For made-to-order items, we agree specifications, lead times and any deposit or cancellation terms in writing before work begins.

Can I request something that is not listed?

Yes. Send us a description or reference picture. We’ll confirm what we can source and the price before you commit.

Returns & refunds

We want your purchase to feel right. If an item arrives damaged, faulty, incomplete or different from what was agreed, contact us on WhatsApp as soon as you can with your order details and, if possible, photos. Keep the item and its packaging while we arrange the next steps.

We’ll review the issue with you and explain the appropriate next steps, including repair, replacement or refund where applicable. Sending photos helps us resolve issues; it does not replace your rights.

If you change your mind, contact us promptly before returning anything. We’ll explain the available options, collection arrangements and any reasonable return costs before you proceed. Any specific conditions for made-to-order products will be explained before you pay.

For an approved refund, we confirm the amount, payment method and expected processing date with you. These terms do not limit your rights under applicable Nigerian consumer protection law.

Your privacy

Futarian Home Deco operates this store in Akure, Ondo State, Nigeria. Contact us through the WhatsApp link below for questions about your information.

What this website stores

Your cart and wishlist are saved in your browser on this device. They are not customer accounts and are not automatically sent to us. If you share a device, other people using the same browser may see these saved items. You can remove items individually or use the button below to clear them.

Product content and product photos are served using Supabase when the store is connected. The web host and service providers may process technical information, such as IP address and request logs, to deliver and secure the service. The site uses local system fonts. We do not add advertising pixels or analytics trackers.

Catalogue photos use public links and may be cached on devices for up to a year. Anyone with a photo link can view it, including photos attached to draft products. Removing a product or photo cannot recall copies already downloaded. We do not upload customer or payment documents to this photo storage.

When you contact us

Continuing to WhatsApp opens a message containing your selected products, quantities and any note you entered. You choose whether to send it. WhatsApp operates under its own privacy terms. We receive information you send, such as your name, phone number, order details and delivery address, to answer enquiries, fulfil orders and resolve issues.

We share only the delivery details needed with a delivery partner when arranging an order. We retain order and payment records for fulfilment, support and applicable recordkeeping obligations, and delete information when it is no longer needed. Ask us for access, correction or deletion of your information; some records may need to be retained for legal obligations. We do not sell customer information or add you to marketing lists without your permission.

Admin login sessions are stored in the admin browser’s session storage and cleared on sign-out. Customer browsing does not require this login.

Terms of shopping

Listed prices are in Nigerian naira. Delivery, assembly and any customisation costs are confirmed separately before payment. We will explain any pricing error before accepting your order; you can decide whether to proceed.

Availability can change until your order is confirmed. A wishlist, cart or WhatsApp enquiry does not reserve stock. We will confirm your product specification, payment and delivery arrangements in writing. Photos, styling props and room settings do not imply a bundle. Please check the individual listing and ask us if anything is unclear.

Keep your order confirmation and payment acknowledgement. If you need help, contact us first so we can work towards a solution. Nothing on this page excludes statutory consumer rights.
